build.beforeDevCommand: bash -c 'd="$PWD"; while [ "$d" != "/" ] && [ ! -f "$d/packages/supervisor/src/main.ts" ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; exec npm --prefix "$d" --workspace @harness/ui run serve'
build.beforeBuildCommand: bash -c 'd="$PWD"; while [ "$d" != "/" ] && [ ! -f "$d/packages/supervisor/src/main.ts" ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; npm --prefix "$d" --workspace @harness/ui run build && node "$d/scripts/stage-desktop.mjs"'

security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost http://127.0.0.1:* http://localhost:* ws://127.0.0.1:* ws://localhost:*; img-src 'self' data: blob: asset:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval'; worker-src 'self' blob:; frame-src 'self' blob: data: http: https:
